mapper.insert: INSERT INTO games.garden_stat (family_id, stat_date, care_cnt, plant_cnt, harvest_cnt, coin_in, coin_out, xp_gain) VALUES (#{familyId}, #{statDate}, #{care}, #{plant}, #{harvest}, #{coinIn}, #{coinOut}, #{xp}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE care_cnt = care_cnt + #{care}, plant_cnt = plant_cnt + #{plant}, harvest_cnt = harvest_cnt + #{harvest}, coin_in = coin_in + #{coinIn}, coin_out = coin_out + #{coinOut}, xp_gain = xp_gain + #{xp}
